company.name: Farnhaus Plants
company.greeting: Hi! I can answer questions about shipping, returns, payment, and plant care. What would you like to know?
company.note: Demo project: Farnhaus Plants is a fictional company.

entries.question: How much is shipping?
entries.answer: Shipping within Germany costs €5.90. Orders of €59 or more ship free. Large plants over 1.20 m are delivered by freight carrier for a flat fee of €29.

entries.question: How long does delivery take?
entries.answer: We ship Monday through Wednesday so no plant spends the weekend in a parcel depot. Orders placed by Wednesday noon go out the same week; delivery then usually takes 1–2 business days.

entries.question: Which countries do you ship to?
entries.answer: We ship to Germany, Austria, the Netherlands, Belgium, and Luxembourg. Unfortunately, we can't ship to Switzerland because of its plant health regulations.

entries.question: Do you ship in winter?
entries.answer: Yes. Below 5 °C (41 °F), we pack every plant with a heat pack and insulation. During a hard freeze below −8 °C (18 °F), we briefly hold orders and email you the new ship date.

entries.question: Where is my package?
entries.answer: As soon as your package is on its way, we email you a tracking link. You'll also find the link in your account under “Orders.”

entries.question: Can I change or cancel my order?
entries.answer: Yes, as long as it hasn't been packed yet. Just reply to your order confirmation or use “Talk to a person.” If the package is already on its way, you can return the plants after they arrive.

entries.question: How much do your plants cost?
entries.answer: Each plant’s price is shown on its product page, including VAT and the pot it ships in. Prices depend on the size; the product page lists every available size with its own price.

entries.question: How do I redeem a voucher?
entries.answer: Enter the code in the “Voucher” field in your cart. You can use one discount code per order; gift cards can be combined freely.

entries.question: Where can I find my invoice?
entries.answer: The invoice isn't in the package. We email it as a PDF once your order ships, and you can download it again anytime from your account.

entries.question: Which payment methods do you accept?
entries.answer: You can pay by credit card, direct debit, instant bank transfer, or invoice. Pay-by-invoice is available for orders up to €500, with 14 days to pay.

entries.question: How do I return an order?
entries.answer: You can return items within 14 days of receiving them. Register the return in your account under “Orders” and we'll send you a free return label. Please send plants back in their original packaging.

entries.question: When will I get my money back?
entries.answer: Once your return reaches us, we refund the amount within 5 business days to your original payment method.

entries.question: My plant arrived damaged. What now?
entries.answer: We're sorry about that. Please send us a photo of the plant and the packaging within 3 days via “Talk to a person” or by email. We'll send a free replacement or refund the purchase price — you don't need to send the plant back.

entries.question: How often should I water my plant?
entries.answer: Water most houseplants only when the top 2–3 cm (about an inch) of soil is dry — roughly once a week in summer, less often in winter. Soggy soil is the most common reason plants die. Every plant from us comes with its own care card with exact details.

entries.question: When should I repot?
entries.answer: Repot in spring when roots grow out of the bottom of the pot. Choose a pot 2–4 cm (about 1–1.5 inches) wider and fresh houseplant soil. Please wait 2–3 weeks before repotting a freshly delivered plant.

entries.question: Where should I put my plant?
entries.answer: Most foliage plants like a bright spot without direct midday sun, such as an east- or west-facing window. Every plant in our shop is labeled by light needs: “shade,” “bright,” or “sunny.”

entries.question: Which plants are toxic to cats and dogs?
entries.answer: Some popular plants, such as Monstera, pothos, and dieffenbachia, are toxic to cats and dogs. In our shop you can filter by “pet-friendly”; that includes calathea, spider plant, and pilea, for example.

entries.question: My plant has pests. What helps?
entries.answer: First, move the plant away from your other plants. For fungus gnats, let the soil dry out more and put up yellow sticky traps; spider mites and aphids can be rinsed off with lukewarm water. If pests show up within 14 days of delivery, send us a photo.

entries.question: What do I do with my plants while I'm on vacation?
entries.answer: For up to two weeks, it's usually enough to water your plants thoroughly beforehand and move them a little farther from the window. For longer trips, we recommend clay watering spikes, which you'll find in our “Accessories” section.

entries.question: I forgot my password.
entries.answer: Click “Forgot password?” on the sign-in page. We'll email you a link to set a new password. The link is valid for 60 minutes.

entries.question: How do I unsubscribe from the newsletter?
entries.answer: Every newsletter has an “Unsubscribe” link at the bottom. You can also turn off the newsletter in your account under “Settings.”

entries.question: Do you offer a growth guarantee?
entries.answer: Yes. If a plant dies within 30 days of delivery despite proper care, we'll replace it free of charge. Just send us a photo and a quick note about where the plant was placed.

entries.question: How can I reach customer service?
entries.answer: Our team is available Mon–Fri, 9 am–5 pm, by email at help@farnhaus.example. Use “Talk to a person” here in the chat to send us your question along with the chat history.
